title: No Friday summaries and no director gate
detect_signals: No Friday summaries in the calendar
Weeks with no faculty contact at all
sim_effect: Faculty trust drifts down unnoticed and the faculty partner slows; a late director review can force a date change.
accepted_fixes: Send a Friday summary every week there is no working session, and add a director gate before QA
Keep faculty contact at least every two weeks and book the director review before QA starts
partial_fixes: Add a director gate in launch week
Send a summary only at milestones
concept: Stakeholder management: steady contact and a clear approval gate
sop_ref: PM SOP: weekly summaries; timelines reviewed by the directors
explanation: Faculty who hear nothing for weeks lose trust and respond slower, and bad news found late costs more. A director gate before QA catches problems while the date can still hold.
note: Planted on the three original projects; the plants name tasks the newer projects do not have.
